Safety First

Important Safety Rules

Please follow these easy rules to stay safe and enjoy your crackers happily.

📏

Keep Distance

Always maintain a safe distance of at least 5 meters from any lit firework.

🕯️

Use a Lighter/Agarbatti

Use a long stick or agarbatti to light crackers. Never use matchsticks or lighters directly.

👨‍👩-👧

Adult Supervision

Children must always be supervised by adults while lighting any type of firework.

🪣

Water Bucket Handy

Always keep a bucket of water or sand nearby to extinguish any accidental fires or used crackers.

🌳

Open Space Only

Only light fireworks in open grounds or terraces. Never light them inside the house or near vehicles.

👕

Cotton Clothes

Wear thick cotton clothes while lighting crackers. Avoid loose or synthetic clothing.

⚠️

Emergency Note

In case of any minor burns, immediately wash the area with cold water. For any serious injuries, please contact your nearest medical center immediately.

Emergency: 108
